slices.intention: compile typed event waits through an exact owned-event locator without promoting allocation or public controls

compatibilityRisks: A raw-name wait bypasses product EventId ownership
A locator result crosses workspace, run, generation, definition, or instance ownership
A registry or schema mismatch reaches the component await
A typed event loses its actual Convex validator or inferred payload type
existingModuleRepairChecklist.promptVersioningImpact: The event definition, schema, validated instance key, and generation-bound locator comparison are immutable workflow-version inputs.

workPackages.templateResolutionPath: Add only the shared typed definition, owned locator contract, exact pre-await comparison, and ID-bound executor while leaving event semantics restricted. Mandatory stack 2B will add persistence, allocation, authenticated send/public translation, generator projection, and semantic promotion.

slices.rationale: The compiler can safely await a component event only after an opaque owned locator proves every immutable identity field and supplies the shared validator.
